speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned weakness and decreased sensation in your right arm; can you tell me exactly when these symptoms started and if they came on suddenly or gradually?

speaker: Patient
text: 55-year-old male bodybuilder. The patient has been experiencing weakness in his right arm for a few weeks, which has progressively worsened to the point of dropping objects. He also reports a recent unexplained weight loss of 17 pounds and has a history of diabetes. The patient admits to chronic alcohol use, heavy smoking, and anabolic steroid use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancoast tumor (superior sulcus tumor).

Based on your significant weight loss, chronic smoking history, and the progression of weakness and sensory loss in your right arm, I suspect a lung cancer located at the top of the lung pressing on your nerves. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_CTA to visualize the lung apex and surrounding structures.
